Talent0_2Ability.name: 身经百战
Talent0_2Ability.SpecificEffects: 遭受主动攻击后，若自身耐久值低于<color=#F74848>50%</color>，战后立即发动<color=#F74848>1</color>次修理背包的被动修理效果；根据当前已损失的耐久值获得<buf ID=1016502>[振奋Ⅰ]</buf>，当前每损失<color=#F74848>10%</color>耐久值获得<color=#F74848>1</color>层，可叠加<color=#F74848>5</color>层

Talent3_5Ability.name: 身经百战
Talent3_5Ability.SpecificEffects:
遭受主动攻击后，若自身耐久值低于<color=#F74848>50%</color>，战后立即发动<color=#F74848>1</color>次修理背包的被动修理效果；根据当前已损失的耐久值获得<buf ID=1016502>[振奋Ⅰ]</buf>，当前每损失<color=#F74848>10%</color>耐久值获得<color=#F74848>1</color>层，可叠加<color=#F74848>5</color>层；
通过天赋触发修理效果时，可修复<color=#F74848>1</color>个损毁部位；出击时，获得<buf ID=1016514>[极限意志]</buf>

100001.name: Mobile Warfare 1
100001.SpecificEffects: After breaking a part, <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> can be triggered. Unable to move before the attack, and this can be effective up to <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn.

101602.name: 战地重整
101602.describe: 恢复单台机兵所有部位的耐久值，修理量为修理背包的<color=#F74848>1.6</color>倍，可修复<color=#F74848>1</color>个损毁部位；每有<color=#F74848>1</color>层<buf ID=900127>[振奋]</buf>，修理倍率<color=#F74848>+0.1</color>

101603.name: 扮猪吃虎
101603.SpecificEffects: 对战时，若自身耐久值百分比低于目标，暴击率和暴击伤害提升<color=#F74848>10%</color>

101604.name: 双刃锯
101604.describe:
使用电锯攻击单个目标，造成<color=#F74848>1.35</color>倍伤害，必定攻击躯干；
战前扣除自身所有部位相当于最大耐久值<color=#F74848>20%</color>的耐久值，并对目标所有部位造成其<color=#F74848>20%</color>最大耐久值的<buf ID=900017>[固定伤害]</buf>，此耐久值扣除和<buf ID=900017>[固定伤害]</buf>均无法破坏部位

101605.name: 昂扬奋发
101605.SpecificEffects: 触发自身天赋修理效果时，驱散自身<color=#F74848>1</color>个减益效果

101606.name: 制敌一击
101606.describe: 使用电锯攻击单个目标，造成<color=#F74848>1.8</color>倍伤害，每有<color=#F74848>1</color>层<buf ID=900127>[振奋]</buf>，伤害倍率<color=#F74848>+0.15</color>

101607.name: 防反大师
101607.SpecificEffects: 在敌方回合时，造成伤害提升<color=#F74848>15%</color>，遭受伤害降低<color=#F74848>10%</color>

101608.name: 破釜沉舟
101608.describe: 扣除自身所有部位的耐久值，相当于最大耐久值的<color=#F74848>50%</color>，无法破坏部位，并获得<color=#F74848>3</color>AP和<buf ID=7100902>[移动力提升]</buf>，持续<color=#F74848>2</color>回合，之后可发动<buf ID=900005>[再行动]</buf>，使用完整移动力移动

100011.name: Mobile Warfare 2
100011.SpecificEffects: Upon triggering <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf>, allows movement of <color=#F74848>2</color> tiles before attacking.

100021.name: Mobile Warfare 3
100021.SpecificEffects: Destroying the target can trigger <buf ID=900005>[Re-Act]</buf>, allowing action with full movement distance.

100022.name: Power Innovation 2
100022.SpecificEffects: When breaking a part, restore <color=#F74848>1</color> AP after combat, effective up to <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

100031.name: Alacrity 1
100031.SpecificEffects: During an Active Attack with a Melee Weapon, there is a <color=#F74848>20%</color> chance to trigger <buf ID=900001>[Flurry Strike]</buf> following the enemy’s attack, dealing <color=#F74848>0.5x</color> DMG.

100033.name: Mobile Warfare 4
100033.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> or <buf ID=900005>[Re-Act]</buf>'s effective times per turn <color=#F74848>+1</color>.

100034.name: Alacrity 2
100034.SpecificEffects: Before an Active Attack, the probability of triggering <buf ID=900001>[Flurry Strike]</buf> increases by <color=#F74848>6%</color> for each <color=#F74848>1</color> tile moved, up to <color=#F74848>30%</color>.

100035.name: Alacrity 3
100035.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900001>[Flurry Strike]</buf> damage multiplier is increased to <color=#F74848>0.75</color>.

100036.name: Alacrity 4
100036.SpecificEffects: When triggering <buf ID=900001>[Flurry Strike]</buf>, prioritize hitting the part with the lowest HP.

101641.name: 离岛者1
101641.SpecificEffects: 装备电锯遭受攻击对战时，若无法反击将发动<buf ID=900008>[奔袭]</buf>，战后自动朝攻击者移动<color=#F74848>3</color>格，若成功移至目标身边则会使用电锯发动<buf ID=900009>[奔袭反击]</buf>，造成<color=#F74848>0.8</color>倍伤害，攻击后返回原地

100043.name: Power Innovation 3
100043.SpecificEffects: When destroying a target, additionally restore <color=#F74848>1</color> AP after combat, effective up to <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn.

101644.name: 离岛者2
101644.SpecificEffects: 行动结束时，若自身<buf ID=900127>[振奋]</buf>层数大于等于<color=#F74848>5</color>，回复<color=#F74848>1</color>点AP

101646.name: 离岛者4
101646.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900127>[振奋]</buf>最大叠加层数增加<color=#F74848>3</color>层，并且每层额外使伤害提升<color=#F74848>4%</color>
